findings.issue: The claimed target is `ConformalMapping/README.md` L5's "separately scoped follow-on target, the general prime-ends correspondence". The README only says that if prime ends are pursued they will be "scoped as its own follow-on target". No such target exists in the roadmap repo, and the roadmap itself has been declared complete and archived. That leaves the new theorems (the crossing lemma, the radial-limit comparison and the arc theorem) with no current target to advance.

summary: This adds new prime-end material (the ray-crossing step of Pommerenke's Prop. 2.14), but it advances no current roadmap target: ConformalMapping was declared complete on 2026-10-30 and archived under `Completed/`, and the prime-ends follow-on it cites has never been set up as a target of its own. The mathematics is plausibly worthwhile, so the author should first get a prime-ends roadmap target added in TauCetiRoadmap and then resubmit against it.
